goal.issue: User request 2026-09-17: finish the registered E1 experiment lifecycle
goal.objective: Implement a restartable lifecycle from preregistration and apparatus preflight through verified evidence, acceptance PR, explicitly approved merge, post-merge checks and separately approved issue closure.
goal.pass_definition: Each transition is verified and persisted; replay does not duplicate experiments or PRs; failed attempts retain evidence and budget; exact-head merge and issue-close gates are separate; targeted regression and process-tree tests pass.

validation.command: Targeted unittest discovery for test_e1_lifecycle.py and test_e1_orchestrator.py in the isolated branch, including harmless owned subprocess fixtures; no experiment or remote publication.
validation.timeout_reason: Integration tests deliberately exercise process-tree timeout and cleanup, plus local temporary Git remotes.
